metadata.description: xOS Marketplace — Platform for xOS engines. First-party primitives ship here; third-party contributors (60% revenue share) publish engines in any category. Engines are independently versioned repos. Dependency declarations enforce minimum compatible versions. Installed via Claude Code plugin system.
metadata.branding_note: xOS brand term is 'engine' not 'plugin'. The plugin[] field and .claude-plugin/ convention are Claude Code technical infrastructure — not user-facing terminology.

plugins.name: career-intelligence
plugins.description: Career Intelligence Engine — xHumanOS engine for job search, network, pipeline, sessions. v0.81.0: XOS-215 atomic ledger appends — the session-logger emitted each entry as six separate writes through one redirect, so capture-prompt and capture-response (same turn, same file) could interleave and corrupt entry boundaries; now one write under the same lock the shard resolver uses, with stale-lock breaking and fail-open. v0.77.0: profile↔brand-voice alignment score (XOS-93). v0.76.0: full telemetry + fusion suite — content→DM attribution, conversation→post prompt, weekly inbound insight, profile-change inbound impact, unified career+brand dashboard, follow-up nudge engine, brand→career inbound-pipeline tracker, fail-closed milestone→brand detector. v0.74.0: XOS-133 local beta-funnel + NSM dashboard. All local-only JSONL, XOS_98_TELEMETRY-gated, ZERO network (no-phone-home). Draft-first outreach + Company Action Gate + claim-grounding safety gates throughout.

plugins.name: exponential-developer
plugins.description: v1.2.0: XOS-221 Stage 4 build-reliability — codex exec --sandbox workspace-write (default read-only stalls the builder) + model/effort resilience (inherit config model, effort=high, step-down on capacity, never ultra/xhigh/gpt-5.6-codex) + orchestrator VERIFIES completion (never trust "launched"). v1.1.0: XOS-218 — LOCAL-FIRST GATES: all quality gates run in-pipeline before gh pr create, NOT GitHub Actions (Actions = thin backstop; do not add workflows re-running lint/types/tests/visual/sonar; bans presence-not-substance passes like 'image attachment detected'). Anti-404 visual gate (Stage 5.5): every visual proof must RESOLVE (valid PNG / HTTP 200) AND a named vision reviewer saw the pixels — receipt required. Local Sonar reliability pre-sweep (Stage 6.7) before PR. Adversarial judge-flag verification (Stage 6): line-evidence classify CONFIRMED/DISPROVEN/PRE-EXISTING. Optional XL-staged build (Stage 4). Cost-routed PR watchers + never open-and-wander (Stage 8). v1.0.0: renamed super-developer → exponential-developer (the product name); commands scoped exponential-developer:ship-feature; cross-family (xHumanOS + xTeamOS builders). v0.12.0: XOS-210 receipt half — ship-feature Stage-6 receipt renders cross_family.degraded (read authoritative field, never all_flags[0]) + Stage-8 auto-applies human-merge when a T3+ change had a degraded cross-family review. v0.11.0: cost-routing TEETH (XOS-206) — a PreToolUse Edit/Write/Bash gate (rules/cost-routing-gate) that, during a FRESH /ship-feature run, blocks in-session source writes + deploy/poll loops in the run's worktree and routes them out-of-process (codex exec / claude --model haiku -p); the per-action codification of LLM-OPTIMIZATION. Also persists worktree in the sdlc-work-claim active marker (so the gate can path-scope real runs) and adds DESIGN_REVIEW_MODEL override for Gate-A.7. v0.10.0: Gate-A.7 Design-Reasoning Review (XOS-196) — a FAIL-HARD pre-build stage after Gate-A.5 and before Stage 4. A fresh reviewer reads only the approved spec + Change Manifest, records a structured sidecar verdict, supports objective mechanical skips, Class-A/B adjustment handling, max-two-RED parking, and `rules/design-review-gate` blocks Stage-4 build spawns on missing/stale/RED/UNREACHABLE/Class-B-applied records. v0.9.0: Stage 1/2/5 bodies now INVOKE their superpowers skills (XOS-178) — brainstorming (Stage 1), writing-plans (Stage 2), test-driven-development (Stage 5); previously these were only listed in the summary, so an executing agent ran ad-hoc. Now the stage body is the execution truth, matching Stage 4. Also routes Stage 1 brainstorm + Stage 6 review to domain 0.001% personas (UX→Ive/Jobs), previously only at Stage 5.5. v0.8.0: Stage 5.8 plugin/skill sandbox-install + turn-on verification (XOS-173) — a fail-hard CONDITIONAL stage (by shipped-artifact-class) that installs the built plugin into an isolated sandbox (temp HOME/CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA) and proves it ACTIVATES (skill triggers, engine entrypoint runs, hooks fire) before review; 'merged' != 'activated'. v0.7.0: Gate-A.5 Change-Manifest gate (XOS-164) — a fail-hard cross-family gate between Gate A and the build that forces the builder to enumerate every removal/migration the spec implies; a 'replaces/supersedes'-language spec with an empty −removed/⚙migrated is BLOCKED with the missing removal named. Exponential Developer Engine - global agentic-SDLC ship-feature pipeline for every repo. v0.6.0: Stage 9 PUBLISH+BROADCAST+ENSURE (XOS-142) — post-merge, artifact-class-routed (plugin→marketplace+reload-bulletin; cyborg→route-sync-to-cyborg-agent; workspace→sync.sh; SaaS→cache-bust+client-reload+flag+migration+verify-live) + ship-feature-publish-gate skew detector (installed<marketplace → BLOCK + loud reinstall line). 'Shipped' = activated across the running swarm, not merged. v0.5.0: cross-family judge UNSKIPPABLE (XOS-138) — Stage 6 non-optional + FAIL-HARD, canonical `ship-feature-judge-receipt:v1` in every PR body, merge-gate BLOCKs receiptless `gh pr merge`. v0.4.1: Stage 5.5 (E2E+VISUAL) + 5.6 (/simplify) + 5.7 (rerun). v0.3.0: SELF-CONTAINED SDLC rules via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}. User-scope, workspace_binding=global. Canonical source: Exponential-OS/xos monorepo plugins/cross/exponential-developer (derived vendored mirror, overwritten on each sync).

plugins.name: xdev
plugins.description: xdev v1.0.0 — short-code fast-invoke wrapper for exponential-developer. Provides /xdev:ship as the fast daily form of /exponential-developer:ship-feature (the Agentic SDLC pipeline). Holds NO pipeline copy: commands/ship.md is a one-line namespace delegator to the exponential-developer:ship-feature skill (single source of truth). REQUIRES exponential-developer@xos installed. Canonical source: Exponential-OS/xos plugins/cross/xdev (derived vendored mirror, overwritten on each sync).

plugins.name: co-dialectic
plugins.description: Co-Dialectic v4.40.0 — XOS-213: one liveness rule, mechanically enforced. statusline.sh no longer reimplements the freshness predicate by hand; a shared fixture table drives the canonical evaluator, the user-prompt-submit path and statusline.sh itself, and the suite fails if any two disagree. Fixes two real divergences on the `active` field (legacy string "true" no longer manufactures a false DEGRADED). Builds on v4.39.0 (XOS-237): per-session, turn-relative Protocol-1 liveness — a heartbeat at or after the user prompt stays LIVE regardless of elapsed tool time; missing evidence renders uninitialized, not DEGRADED; precompact packets land in the executing workspace.

plugins.name: knowledge-graph
plugins.description: Knowledge Graph — Graph data layer for all xOS engines. Phase 1: JSON files. Phase 2: Neo4j substrate replacing all engine file stores. Foundational primitive — no dependencies.

plugins.name: brand-amplification
plugins.description: Brand Amplification Engine (xOS) v0.63.0 — XOS-240: linkedin_group platform (group posts were failing a FEED-only link rule for a non-reason) + flywheel-ship-gate, a per-STEP execution gate requiring every in-scope surface to carry a terminal status, a URL, and a URL that resolves — "it shipped" without a URL is unfalsifiable. v0.61.0 — XOS-250: the engine remembers across campaigns; captures attributes, outcomes AND effort so return-on-effort is measurable, and REFUSES to state a direction below 15 campaigns. v0.60.0 — XOS-249: the Draft Handoff Gate leaves evidence; a PreToolUse hook denies a publish whose copy has no matching validation record.

plugins.name: coordination
plugins.description: xOS Coordination Engine v0.5.0 — XOS-140 auto-harvest quotable insights (Stop hook: transcript scan, Gemini Flash extraction, 3 safety-gated sections with keyword HOLD net, idempotent, fail-safe). v0.4.0: solo-session-roles + heartbeat liveness (XOS-120).
